camera.motion: static (phase correlation of monitor / right wall / right table region vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.15 px every frame)

intrinsics_from_task_spec.note: lab camera, HFOV 80 deg, focal = 0.5959 x width; not measured

camera.perspective_cues: Table top is a rectangle seen obliquely from the front and above: front edge 586 px long at y~514, back edge ~280 px long at y~431, so the back edge is about 2x farther than the front edge. The floor/wall junction lines converge toward the centre. The toy's apparent size grows from ~41 px (held by the person, behind the table) to ~95 px (on the table near its front edge): its camera distance roughly halves.
camera.postprocessing: Background was blurred and faces were replaced with flat beige ovals (watermark 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' bottom right). The toy itself is sharp but its own face was also flattened to a beige oval.
